name: animdiagram
description: Looping, self-contained animated SVG explainer diagrams: packets travelling along orthogonal connectors with arrival rings and glows, phase captions, ambient streams and growing bars, on a shared CSS-keyframe story clock. Editorial discipline from diagram-design; motion style from SpacetimeDB's scaling series. Ships timeline.py (spec to keyframes), check.py (verifier) and preview.py (scrubber).
